jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100769

26WD100769 Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy and Analytics

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing
Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth
Drive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomes
Define Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomes
Drive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programs
Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes
Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight
Drive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teams
Demonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectiveness
Strong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environments
Experience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioning
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendations
Proven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teams
Demonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisions
Ability to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impact
BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

_________________________________________________________________________

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entreprise
Diriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talents
Favoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affaires
Définir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clients
Optimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmes
Établir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affaires
Faire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriée
Favoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèle
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou dispersées
Une expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketing
Une solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affaires
Une expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA
Capacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètes
Capacité avérée à communiquer avec des intervenants de haut niveau non spécialisés dans le domaine technique et à les influencer, tout en établissant des partenariats solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML, de technologie marketing et d’autres équipes techniques

jobs.description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.

Drives regional growth through the acquisition of new commercial customer accounts. Applies advanced knowledge of products, market trends, and prospect needs to develop innovative solutions.

Identifying prospective commercial customers, generating leads, and converting them into clients.
Contacting new commercial customers to discuss their needs.

Lead regional commercial account initiatives to achieve significant revenue growth.

Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage complex prospect relationships.

Excellent communication and influence skills with the ability to align diverse stakeholders around business objectives.

jobs.description:

Position Overview:

Finning Canada is hiring a Permanent, Full-time Senior Director, Commercial Finance & Performance Management (CFPM), based in either Edmonton or Calgary.

Reporting to the Vice President, Finance & Supply Chain, this role represents one of the most senior and influential finance leadership positions within Finning Canada. As the senior commercial finance leader for a ~$6B revenue business, the Senior Director, CFPM plays a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, optimizing capital deployment, and strengthening commercial governance across the organization. Partnering closely with Canadian Operations, this leader oversees the Commercial & Financial Business Partnering team and serves as a trusted advisor to senior and executive leadership, translating strategy into actionable financial insight.

Leading a high-performing team of finance leaders, the role champions strong commercial acumen, best-in-class budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning, and delivers insightful financial and operational reporting to enable data-driven decision-making and effective performance management. With significant exposure to the Canadian leadership team and the broader Finning Executive, this role offers the opportunity to lead high-impact initiatives, influence enterprise-wide strategy, and shape the financial future of the business. Positioned as a key succession role to the VP, Finance & Supply Chain, this role provides a clear pathway to broader executive accountability and long-term leadership growth within Finning.

Job Description:

Major Job Functions:

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

Drive financial strategy aligned to Finning and Caterpillar objectives
Provide executive decision support and investment governance
Identify competitive trends and growth opportunities
Operate with integrity through maintaining social, ethical and organizational integrity in conducting business activities; maintains confidentiality, adheres to corporate policies and procedures
Accountable for the Commercial Governance for Finning Canada. $6Bn+ of revenue, $500M of EBIT
Accountable for delivering the strategic plan, governance processes and alignment internally with Finning and Caterpillar
Accountable to be a change agent in how we manage and re-shape the business

Drive Financial Performance across the business

Leader in driving, understanding and analysing financial performance on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis
Owner of identifying gaps in performance and implementing action plans to address
Take an objective view, balancing operational and corporate requirements
Identify, communicate, and mitigate potential issues or liabilities; recommend effective solutions
Focus on EBIT, Invested Capital, ROIC and FCF

Financial Planning, Analysis & Reporting

Own budgeting, forecasting, and long‑range plans
Responsible for the efficient management of financial and accounting operations including financial reporting, budgeting, asset management and control
Provide financially sound information and manage the effective flow of that information through financial systems, reports, and dashboards
Ensure high‑quality C‑suite reporting and KPI insight
Improve forecast accuracy and performance analytics

Governance & Capital Discipline

Lead large deal/tender governance and post‑investment review
Approve major commercial decisions and business cases

Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

Act as trusted advisor to the FINCA EC, FLT, and Board
Represent FINCA with Caterpillar and external stakeholders
Lead the CFPM Team, driving engagement, development talent and providing a succession pipeline
100% accountability for results and impact on people by setting a strong example in high performance leadership

Education and Qualifications:

10+ years of relevant industry experience is required
10+ years experience in a leadership capacity
10+ years of progressive accounting experience in related industry or public practice.
Master's or Bachelor’s degree in finance or related degree preferred
Accounting designation or graduate degree preferred
Highly effective senior leadership skills gained through previous leadership experience
Experience leading implementation projects for financial systems at a senior leader level, on a global scale (system examples: BPC, SAP, Hyperion, M3, Peoplesoft, or Other)
Practical experience and theoretical knowledge in Dealership Business Models, end-to-end supply chain management and Financial & Commercial practices
Operational experience across a number of disciplines / functions
Global business strategy and corporate finance knowledge
Advanced general accounting knowledge coupled with a sound understanding of business processes, the interrelationship of business functions, corporate governance issues and operational needs
Knowledge of financial systems with historical proven, positive track record of solution implementation, optimization, and sustainment
Knowledge of the operations of related industry segments
Proficient in the use of MS Office Suite and in-house systems including BPC, M3, Power BI, Concur
Understands and adheres to Finning policies and procedures, including safety, inclusion, and diversity
Ability to determine key performance indicators (KPIs), variance issues and improve internal controls
Experience working with CAT systems, tools, data, or reports including DFRS, CAT dealer portal is preferred
Change management training, experience, and/or PROSCI or Lean Change Agent certification preferred

Soft Skills:

Strong team leadership skills, capable of representing the business at a senior management level with robust stakeholder management.
Effective verbal communication skills, presenting messages clearly, concisely, and directly.
Influencing skills, ability to drive results without direct line responsibility and ensure the wider team are engaged and effective.
Strong Analytical / Problem solving attributes. Ability to Design, interrogate and review Financial and Operational information and create clear and effective understanding with stakeholders.
Advanced Commercial acumen with the ability to drive improvements in financial returns and profitability.
Ability to clearly articulate the value of financial analysis, linked to business results
Must possess highest standard of accuracy and precision and be highly organized
Self motivated and results oriented, with a desire to achieve
Ability to deal with ambiguity and assist in creating sustainable competitive advantage

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enterprise Execution
jobs.description:
Join a Challenger

At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?
The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.

We can’t wait to get to know you!

The Work

The Senior Director, Enterprise Execution is responsible for helping EQB translate strategic priorities into business outcomes.

Working directly with executive leaders across the organization, this role leads a focused portfolio of the Bank's most important enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities. These are high-impact, cross-functional efforts that are critical to delivering EQB's strategy, growth ambitions, and financial objectives. The role serves as a bridge between strategy, execution, and outcomes, ensuring that the Bank's biggest priorities maintain momentum, overcome obstacles, and deliver the impact they were intended to achieve.

Enterprise Execution acts as an execution partner to leadership, bringing structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, and execution discipline to a select group of enterprise priorities. The role combines elements of strategy execution, enterprise leadership, organizational effectiveness, and executive problem-solving, helping translate strategic ambition into measurable results.

The ideal candidate combines the structured problem-solving capabilities of a top-tier strategy consultant with the practical execution mindset of an experienced operator. They are highly comfortable working in ambiguous situations, quickly building credibility with senior stakeholders, and driving progress on complex challenges that cut across multiple business units. They are intellectually curious, commercially minded, and action-oriented. They know how to move seamlessly between strategy and execution, challenge and support, analysis and action. Most importantly, they have a demonstrated ability to help organizations deliver on their most important priorities and achieve meaningful outcomes.

Strategic Initiative Leadership & Enterprise Priorities (55%)

Lead a portfolio of EQB's highest-priority enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities, including CEO- and CFO-sponsored programs.
Partner directly with executive sponsors and act as a trusted advisor to mobilize, accelerate, and deliver initiatives that are critical to achieving the Bank's strategic and financial objectives.
Provide hands-on leadership for complex cross-functional initiatives requiring enterprise coordination, senior stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution.
Shape implementation approaches, execution strategies, operating models, and delivery plans to maximize organizational impact.
Challenge assumptions, strengthen plans, and improve decision-making through structured problem solving and rigorous analysis.
Identify and resolve issues, risks, dependencies, and organizational barriers that could impede successful execution.
Bring an enterprise-wide perspective that helps ensure initiatives advance broader corporate objectives.

Strategic Execution & Outcome Realization (25%)

Ensure approved business cases and strategic objectives translate into measurable business, customer, operational, and financial outcomes.

Position Overview

As the Director of Worldwide Marketing Data Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, measurement frameworks, data foundations, and analytical capabilities that enable Autodesk to understand and optimize Enterprise marketing’s impact on customer and business outcomes. You will lead a global team of data strategists and analysts responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and decision-support capabilities across the enterprise marketing funnel and broader go-to-market ecosystem.

This role reports to the Senior Director of Worldwide Marketing Business Insights & Analytics and plays a critical role in advancing Autodesk’s journey toward audience-centric customer experiences and data-driven commercial decision-making. You will partner closely with Marketing and Go-to-Market leadership and across analytics and technology domains, including Sales, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Marketing Technology.

Responsibilities

Lead Marketing Data & Analytics Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and adoption of marketing analytics, measurement frameworks, and intelligence capabilities, partnering with Marketing leadership to translate business priorities into scalable analytical solutions for Enterprise Marketing
Lead a Global Analytics Team: Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing global team of data strategists and analysts, providing strategic direction, hands-on guidance, and opportunities for talent growth
Drive Business Performance Intelligence: Monitor and analyze business performance to identify emerging trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable levers for Marketing, including early indicators of pipeline performance and opportunities to improve business outcomes
Define Marketing Measurement & Attribution Strategy: Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to establish measurement principles, KPIs, conversion definitions, attribution methodologies and windows, incrementality approaches, and other frameworks for evaluating marketing effectiveness and connecting marketing investment to customer and commercial outcomes
Drive Marketing Effectiveness & Investment Optimization: Integrate attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, and predictive analytics to identify performance drivers and inform resource allocation across audiences, channels, campaigns, and programs
Establish Analytics-Ready Data Foundations: Define the business and analytical requirements for foundational marketing data structures, including data models, taxonomies, event structures, identity resolution, campaign hierarchies, and governance required to reliably connect marketing activity with customer and business outcomes
Advance AI-Powered Analytics & Decisioning: Partner across Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and Marketing to build scalable, governed capabilities that enable AI agents to generate insights, identify opportunities, recommend and optimize decisions, and orchestrate marketing actions with appropriate human oversight
Drive Adoption & Executive Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into clear business implications and recommendations, enabling leaders to understand what happened, why it happened, what is likely to happen next, and what actions should be taken

Minimum Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you have:

10+ years of professional experience with significant domain expertise in B2B marketing, sales, go-to-market, or customer analytics
5+ years of people leadership experience managing and developing technical and analytical talent, preferably across global or distributed teams
Demonstrated experience developing and operationalizing marketing measurement strategies, including attribution, incrementality, experimentation, marketing mix modeling, funnel measurement, and marketing effectiveness
Strong understanding of modern marketing and customer data foundations, including data models, customer and contact identity, campaign and event taxonomies, cloud data platforms, and business intelligence environments
Experience applying predictive analytics, data science, and AI/ML-enabled capabilities to business and marketing problems, with an understanding of the data, governance, and measurement foundations required to support AI-powered analytics and decisioning
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business questions into analytical frameworks, measurement approaches, data requirements, and actionable recommendations
Proven ability to communicate with and influence senior non-technical stakeholders while establishing strong partnerships with Data Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Marketing Technology, and other technical teams
Demonstrated experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and other Go-to-Market functions to drive measurable business outcomes
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear strategic implications, recommendations, and decisions
Ability to lead multiple strategic priorities in a fast-paced, highly cross-functional environment while maintaining high standards for analytical rigor, quality, and business impact
BA/BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or another quantitative or relevant field; advanced degree preferred but not required

26WD100769 Directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales

Aperçu du Poste

En tant que directeur de la stratégie et de l’analyse des données marketing mondiales, vous dirigerez la stratégie, les cadres de mesure, les bases de données et les capacités analytiques qui permettent à Autodesk de comprendre et d’optimiser l’impact du marketing d’entreprise sur les résultats clients et commerciaux. Vous dirigerez une équipe mondiale de stratèges et d’analystes de données chargés de transformer des données complexes en informations exploitables, en intelligence prédictive et en capacités d’aide à la décision à travers l’entonnoir de marketing d’entreprise et l’écosystème de mise en marché au sens large.

Ce poste relève du directeur principal des analyses et des perspectives d’affaires du marketing mondial et joue un rôle essentiel dans la progression d’Autodesk vers des expériences client centrées sur l’auditoire et une prise de décision commerciale fondée sur les données. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les dirigeants du marketing et de la mise en marché, ainsi qu’avec les équipes des domaines de l’analyse et de la technologie, notamment les ventes, la science des données, l’ingénierie des données et la technologie marketing.

Responsabilités

Diriger la stratégie en matière de données et d’analyse marketing : Assumer la responsabilité de la stratégie de bout en bout, de la mise en œuvre et de l’adoption des analyses marketing, des cadres de mesure et des capacités d’intelligence, en collaboration avec la direction du marketing afin de traduire les priorités d’affaires en solutions analytiques évolutives pour le marketing d’entreprise
Diriger une équipe mondiale d’analyse : Recruter, former et diriger une équipe mondiale hautement performante composée de stratèges et d’analystes de données, en fournissant une orientation stratégique, des conseils pratiques et des occasions de développement des talents
Favoriser l’intelligence de la performance d’affaires : Surveiller et analyser la performance d’affaires afin d’identifier les tendances émergentes, les risques, les occasions et les leviers exploitables pour le marketing, y compris les indicateurs précoces de la performance du pipeline et les occasions d’améliorer les résultats d’affaires
Définir la stratégie de mesure et d’attribution marketing : Travailler en partenariat avec les dirigeants des ventes et du marketing pour établir des principes de mesure, des indicateurs de performance clés (IPK), des définitions de conversion, des méthodologies et des fenêtres d’attribution, des approches d’incrémentalité, ainsi que d’autres cadres permettant d’évaluer l’efficacité du marketing et de relier les investissements marketing aux résultats commerciaux et auprès des clients
Optimiser l’efficacité du marketing et les investissements : Intégrer l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing et l’analyse prédictive afin d’identifier les facteurs de performance et d’orienter l’allocation des ressources entre les audiences, les canaux, les campagnes et les programmes
Établir des fondations de données prêtes pour l’analyse : Définir les exigences opérationnelles et analytiques relatives aux structures de données marketing fondamentales, y compris les modèles de données, les taxonomies, les structures d’événements, la résolution d’identité, les hiérarchies de campagnes et la gouvernance nécessaire pour relier de manière fiable les activités marketing aux résultats clients et d’affaires
Faire progresser l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA : Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML d’entreprise, de technologie marketing et de marketing afin de mettre en place des capacités évolutives et régies permettant aux agents d’IA de générer des informations, d’identifier des occasions, de recommander et d’optimiser les décisions, ainsi que d’orchestrer les actions marketing sous une supervision humaine appropriée
Favoriser l’adoption et soutenir la prise de décision de la haute direction : Traduire des résultats analytiques complexes en implications commerciales claires et en recommandations, permettant ainsi aux dirigeants de comprendre ce qui s’est passé, pourquoi cela s’est produit, ce qui est susceptible de se produire ensuite et quelles mesures devraient être prises

Qualifications Minimales

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez posséder :

Plus de 10 ans d’expérience professionnelle avec une expertise approfondie dans les domaines du marketing B2B, des ventes, de la mise en marché ou de l’analyse de la clientèle
Plus de 5 ans d’expérience en leadership, notamment dans la gestion et le développement de talents techniques et analytiques, de préférence au sein d’équipes internationales ou dispersées
Une expérience avérée dans l’élaboration et la mise en œuvre de stratégies de mesure marketing, notamment l’attribution, l’incrémentalité, l’expérimentation, la modélisation du mix marketing, la mesure de l’entonnoir de conversion et l’efficacité marketing
Une solide compréhension des fondements du marketing moderne et des données clients, y compris les modèles de données, l’identité des clients et des contacts, les taxonomies de campagnes et d’événements, les plateformes de données en nuage et les environnements d’intelligence d’affaires
Une expérience dans l’application de l’analyse prédictive, de la science des données et des capacités basées sur l’IA et l’apprentissage automatique (IA/ML) à des problèmes d’affaires et de marketing, avec une compréhension des fondements en matière de données, de gouvernance et de mesure nécessaires pour soutenir l’analyse et la prise de décision alimentées par l’IA
Capacité avérée à traduire des questions d’affaires ambiguës en cadres analytiques, en approches de mesure, en exigences en matière de données et en recommandations concrètes
Capacité avérée à communiquer avec des intervenants de haut niveau non spécialisés dans le domaine technique et à les influencer, tout en établissant des partenariats solides avec les équipes d’ingénierie des données, de science des données, d’IA/ML, de technologie marketing et d’autres équipes techniques

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
